title: Where can you fly direct from Luton Airport?
author: Matt
intro: Luton is easyJet's home airport and a big base for Wizz Air, with flights across Europe, North Africa and beyond. New this winter are direct flights to Lapland, Strasbourg, Rabat and Nuremberg. Here's what flies and how to choose.
seo_title: Luton Airport direct flights: new Lapland routes (2026)
seo_description: easyJet and Wizz Air fly most routes from Luton, and new this winter are Kittilä in Lapland, Strasbourg, Nuremberg and Rabat. Routes checked Nov 2026.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
- **Main airlines:** easyJet and Wizz Air
- **Also flying:** Ryanair and TUI
- **New for winter:** Lapland and Strasbourg
- **Long-haul:** almost none direct

We checked these routes in November 2026. Routes and days of the week change every season, so check the airline's timetable before you plan a trip around one.

sections.heading: Who flies from Luton
sections.text:
easyJet has its headquarters at Luton and flies the widest range of routes, from city breaks to winter sun. Luton is also Wizz Air's main UK base, with flights to cities such as [Budapest](/destinations/budapest) and [Kraków](/destinations/krakow), and a growing list of Spanish routes. Ryanair and TUI fly some routes too.

Luton is a short and medium-haul airport. For long-haul flights to the USA or Asia, most people fly from Heathrow or Gatwick, or connect through a European hub.

sections.heading: New routes for winter 2026/27
sections.text:
| Route | Airline | From | How often |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| [Strasbourg](/destinations/strasbourg) | easyJet | 29 November 2026 | four a week |
| [Nuremberg](/destinations/nuremberg) | easyJet | 23 November 2026 | see timetable |
| Rabat | easyJet | 5 November 2026 | twice a week |

Kittilä is the airport for Levi, one of Finland's biggest ski resorts, about 15 minutes away. The Lapland flights run until late February, which covers the Christmas trips and the best of the snow.

sections.heading: Lapland direct from Luton
sections.text:
The new Kittilä route is the big news for families. Flying direct to Levi means no change in Helsinki and no long transfer at the other end, which matters with small children and ski bags.

- **December:** the Christmas trips, with highs around -8°C and only a few hours of daylight.
- **January and February:** colder, at around -10°C, but quieter, with more daylight and a better chance of the northern lights.
- **What to book:** snowsuits and boots are often included in Lapland packages, so check before buying your own.

With only two flights a week, most trips will be three or four nights, or a full week. Our [quietest time to visit Lapland](/blog/quietest-time-to-visit-lapland) guide covers when crowds and prices drop.

sections.heading: Christmas markets
sections.text:
This is the winter to fly to a Christmas market from Luton. The new [Strasbourg](/destinations/strasbourg) flights start on 29 November, in time for one of Europe's oldest markets, and [Nuremberg](/destinations/nuremberg) has the famous Christkindlesmarkt. On a four-a-week route, the flight days decide your trip, so check them before booking a hotel.

Our guides to [Strasbourg or Colmar at Christmas](/blog/strasbourg-or-colmar-at-christmas) and the [best Christmas markets in Europe](/blog/best-christmas-markets-in-europe) will help you choose.

Tip: Christmas market weekends sell out early. Book flights and hotels together, and pick a Sunday-to-Thursday stay if you can for lower prices and quieter stalls.

sections.heading: Winter sun
sections.text:
For winter sun, the Canaries are the warmest choice within about four and a half hours, at around 20 to 22°C in December to February. easyJet and other airlines fly from Luton to the islands, including [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) and [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote).

For something different, [Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech) is under four hours away, and the new Rabat flights add Morocco's calmer capital. [Málaga](/destinations/malaga) is milder, at about 17°C, which suits city days and walking more than the beach.

Watch out: Luton is a busy airport with early-morning peaks. Our guide to [how early to arrive at Luton Airport](/blog/how-early-should-you-arrive-at-luton-airport) covers bag drop times and the DART shuttle from Luton Airport Parkway station.

sections.heading: Where could you go from Luton?
sections.text:
For a festive break, try [Strasbourg](/destinations/strasbourg) or [Nuremberg](/destinations/nuremberg). For snow, [Levi](/destinations/levi) is now direct. For a week of sun, look at [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) or [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote). The [Christmas holidays](/destinations/christmas-holidays) and [city breaks](/destinations/city-breaks) pages have more ideas.

If your family can't agree, read our guide to [deciding where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday), or add a few ideas to somewhere.party and let the draw decide.

faqs.question: Which airlines fly from Luton Airport?
faqs.answer: Mainly easyJet, which has its headquarters there, and Wizz Air. Ryanair and TUI fly some routes too.

faqs.question: Can you fly direct from Luton to Lapland?
faqs.answer: Yes. easyJet flies from Luton to Kittilä, the airport for Levi, twice a week from 24 November 2026 to late February 2027.

faqs.question: Can you fly direct from Luton to Strasbourg?
faqs.answer: Yes. easyJet starts flying from Luton to Strasbourg on 29 November 2026, four times a week.

faqs.question: Are there long-haul flights from Luton?
faqs.answer: Not really. Luton is mainly a European airport. For the USA or Asia, most people fly from Heathrow or Gatwick, or connect through a European hub.
